items.title: Software bug freezes Chase: Is it the time for bitcoin?
items.summary:
Scott Melker discusses an hours-long Chase (JPM) outage and whether decentralized bitcoin (BTC-USD) matters more now than ever.

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: JPMorgan CFO Jeremy Barnum to step down as Jamie Dimon's succession plans take shape
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase said Tuesday that longtime chief financial officer Jeremy Barnum will step down next year in the latest change among the top ranks of the country's largest bank as it prepares for CEO Jamie Dimon's eventual succession.

items.title: JPMorgan’s CFO plans exit, company names internal successor
items.summary: Jeremy Barnum has decided to step down after six years as JPMorgan’s chief financial officer. He will be succeeded by Bregje de Best, the 43-year-old CFO of the bank’s corporate and investment banking unit.
